# dsh-kit

> Generator, template and verification baseline for DeepSeek Harness plugins.

## Repository

https://github.com/dsh-kit/dsh-kit

## Commands

    pnpm install
    pnpm check
    pnpm verify:template
    pnpm docs:build

## Read next

- README.md — project overview and quick start
- AGENTS.md — repository rules and commands
- CONTRIBUTING.md — review, merge and SSOT policy
- ROADMAP.md — direction, not a schedule
- docs/guide/quick-start.md — the user-facing guide

## Contracts

- Package: create-dsh-kit
- Node >=24; pnpm 12 (npm fallback)
- Generated project: src/host, src/client, tests, lib, AGENTS.md, llms.txt
